_comment: Aldric the Provisioner, Lumora's general goods vendor (Scripts/talking_vendor_npc.gd since 2026-09-24; Data/vendor_shop.json 'lumora_general_goods'). Cheerful, practical, always short of traveller's packs. Quest: Aldric's Furs. {word} in a line is a clickable keyword. ALL LINES ARE DRAFTS.
greeting: Welcome, welcome! If you're going out there, you'll want more water than you think.
Aldric's the name, provisions are the game. Rations, water, torches, tools.
Back again? Good. The desert eats supplies.
shop_intro: Everything a traveller needs, and a few things they didn't know they needed.
Kits for every trade, if you've a mind to make things. Patterns too — cloth and leather.
ambient: Two flasks of water per day out there. Three if you're a fool. Four if you're a fighter.
Sold my last traveller's pack an hour ago. Again.
wrong_item: Aldric turns it over. "Kind of you, but I can't sell that."

sequence: I can't keep traveller's packs on the shelf. Every would-be hero in Lumora wants one.
Bring me six fur pelts and ten leather scraps — the animals and the brigands out there carry plenty — and I'll pay you in patterns.

lines: Six fur pelts, ten leather scraps. Hand them over whenever you have them.
Are those pelts? Wonderful! Hand them here.
Welcome! Say, you wouldn't be going hunting? I need {furs} for packs.
